title: Act 2 - Chapter 8: Route 46 Mountain Descent & Johto Finale
synopsis: Descend the rocky mountain switchbacks of Route 46 south from Blackthorn City, battling Graveler, Gligar, and Donphan across the cliffside trails and confronting the static Slaking Lv. 45 blocking the lower pass. Arrive in the quiet frontier hamlet of New Bark Town to claim a second Johto starter (Chikorita, Cyndaquil, or Totodile) from Prof. Elm's Lab, receive the Waterfall HM tool, and try your luck at the Blackjack Dealer. With all seven Johto Badges secured, Act 2 draws to a close — the Sevii Islands and true endgame await.
